hooks.command: CC_MARKER=$(head -c8 /dev/urandom | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n'); CC_PID=$PPID; while [ "$CC_PID" -gt 1 ]; do CC_TTY=$(readlink /proc/$CC_PID/fd/0 2>/dev/null); case $CC_TTY in /dev/pts/*) break;; esac; CC_PID=$(awk '/PPid/{print $2}' /proc/$CC_PID/status 2>/dev/null); done; printf '\033]0;cc:%s\007' "$CC_MARKER" > "$CC_TTY" 2>/dev/null; curl -sf -X POST "http://localhost:9000/hooks/session-start?wm=$CC_MARKER&wts=${WT_SESSION:-}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat '__CC_SECRET_FILE__' 2>/dev/null)" -d @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

P=$(cat); TP=$(printf '%s' "$P" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$TP" ] && [ -f "$TP" ]; then L=$(tac "$TP" 2>/dev/null | jq -c 'select(.type=="assistant") | (.message.content // []) | if type=="string" then . else (map(select(.type=="text") | .text) | join("\n")) end | select(length>0) | .[0:8000]' 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -n "$L" ]; then P2=$(printf '%s' "$P" | jq -c --argjson lam "$L" '. + {last_assistant_message: $lam}' 2>/dev/null) && P="$P2"; fi; fi; printf '%s' "$P" | curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:9000/hooks/stop -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat '__CC_SECRET_FILE__' 2>/dev/null)" -d @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:9000/hooks/notification -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat '__CC_SECRET_FILE__' 2>/dev/null)" -d @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:9000/hooks/session-end -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat '__CC_SECRET_FILE__' 2>/dev/null)" -d @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
